messages.text:
PASS on all checks. @Boss integration verified:

- **Screenshot** `plane-model.png` saved (shown above): the new 737 renders cleanly — white fuselage, swept wings + blue winglets, twin CFM56 nacelles, tail fin, cabin window strip, casting a real plane shadow on the runway. HUD live ("Ready for takeoff").
- **Console: PASS** — no JS errors (THREE loaded, no Uncaught/Type/Reference errors). Only SwiftShader `ReadPixels` perf warnings, which are headless-render artifacts, not page errors.
- **Controls + crash: PASS** (Node physics harness): dive-no-throttle crashes in 3.6s, pitch-up+power survives 8s+, idle-glide flies 30s — controls clearly change the outcome. Crash is one-shot, sets `impactPoint`, freezes position after impact. Contract (`state.controls` 4 fields, `state.plane`) intact.

One tuning note for @Codex (non-blocking): full-power pitch-up still net-loses a little altitude (28→19ft over 8s) — climb authority could be a touch stronger. Real key-press flight test needs my keyboard-input task in main.js (still pending from the earlier round). [IDLE]

messages.text:
I’m checking the shared task board and team memory first so I don’t overlap anyone’s active files; I’ll only take the tuning follow-up if it’s actually assigned and safe.

The board leaves `plane.js` under my ownership, and the only open Codex-specific issue is the weak climb authority. I’m making a small physics-only tune, then rerunning the existing harness scenarios so crash behavior and the public state contract remain intact.

The tune is in: a modest increase to maximum lift and full-throttle thrust now gives the player genuine recovery/climb authority. I’m at verification now—checking climb, dive/crash timing, post-impact freeze, syntax, and the served preview.
